name: VisDiaHalBench
description: VisDiaHalBench is a visual dialogue hallucination evaluation benchmark designed to diagnose hallucination problems in large vision-language models by using five-turn questions about edited and original images grounded by annotated scene graphs.
reputation: A recent ACL benchmark that has gained attention in the vision-language hallucination literature for fine-grained dialogue-based hallucination diagnosis.
notes: Focuses on multi-turn dialogue consistency and hallucination in LVLMs; uses edited images and scene graph grounding.
